svg.title: Holman Fig. 9-8 — water boiling on a 0.6 mm platinum wire
svg.text: Holman Fig. 9-8 — water boiling on a 0.6 mm platinum wire
q/A against ΔTx, one curve per pressure (psia, MPa in brackets); digitized from the slide chart
Mark ΔTx = 242 − 212 = 30°F on the ΔTx axis (16.7°C on the lower scale).
Go straight up to the 14.7 psia (0.101 MPa, 1 atm) curve.
Go across to the q/A axis (log scale).
Read (q/A)_Pt = 3×10⁵ Btu/h·ft² (≈ 0.95 MW/m² on the right scale).
Redrawn from the slide chart; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
